units.source_text: 很快我就安心地睡着了。

en.t: Before long, I fell asleep peacefully.

units.source_text: 但是，突然听到有人叫我的名字，便惊醒了。

en.t: But suddenly I heard someone call my name and woke with a start.

units.source_text: 睁眼一看，隔扇开了两尺左右，K黑乎乎的身影立在那里。

en.t: When I opened my eyes, the sliding partition was open about two feet, and K's dark silhouette was standing there.

units.source_text: 因为他的房间依然像天刚黑时那样亮着灯。

en.t: His room was still lit, just as it had been when night first fell.

units.source_text: 由于刚刚惊醒，我只是迷迷瞪瞪地望着眼前的景象，一时间说不出话来。

en.t: Having just been startled awake, I only stared dazedly at the scene before me and could not speak for a while.
Then K asked, 'Were you already asleep?'
K usually went to bed very late.

units.source_text: 我望着他那剪影般黑乎乎的身影，反问：‘有什么事？’

en.t: Looking at his dark, silhouette-like figure, I asked back, 'What is it?'

units.source_text: 他只是说：‘没什么要紧事，去上厕所回来，顺便看看你睡没睡。’

en.t: He only said, 'Nothing important. I was coming back from the toilet and just looked in to see whether you were asleep.'

units.source_text: 他背朝着灯光，所以我一点也看不出他的脸色和神情，但他的声音倒比平日要沉稳得多。

en.t: Since his back was to the light, I could not make out his complexion or expression at all, but his voice was much calmer than usual.

units.source_text: 然后，K‘哗啦’一声关紧了隔扇，我的房间又回归了原来的黑暗。

en.t: Then K slid the partition shut with a clatter, and my room returned to its former darkness.

units.source_text: 为了在黑暗中平静地进入梦乡，我又闭上了眼睛，很快便睡着了。

en.t: To drift peacefully back into dreams in the darkness, I closed my eyes again and soon fell asleep.

units.source_text: 但是第二天早上，一想起昨晚的事情，我总觉得有些蹊跷，说不定是自己做梦吧。

en.t: But the next morning, when I thought back on what had happened the night before, it seemed strange to me, and I wondered whether I might have dreamed it.

units.source_text: 于是吃饭的时候，我问了K，他说昨夜确实打开隔扇，叫过我的名字。

en.t: So at breakfast I asked K, and he said that he had indeed opened the partition last night and called my name.

units.source_text: 我问他为什么叫我时，却没有得到明确的回答。

en.t: When I asked why he had called me, however, I received no clear answer.

units.source_text: 可就在我已经没有心情说这事的时候，他却问我：‘近来睡得可好？’

en.t: But just when I no longer felt like talking about it, he asked me, 'Have you been sleeping well lately?'
I felt that there was something a little strange about him.
